locked_title: Graph Convolutional Network based on Hyperbolic Space for Power Load Forecasting

forecast_semantics.input: per-node load history ending at processed origin t
forecast_semantics.target: one scalar load value for every frozen node at processed position t+24
forecast_semantics.elapsed_time_caveat: A processed-position lead is not silently relabelled as elapsed hours when source rows are absent.
forecast_semantics.normalization: fit per node from training-prefix values only and reuse unchanged for validation and test

ausgrid_hierarchy.semantics: 12 source-manifest customer leaves, four deterministic source-manifest regional sums, and one system sum
ausgrid_hierarchy.identity_rule: leaf IDs, leaf selection, and four region memberships must be copied from and hashed with the frozen source data manifest; the implementation must not infer or fabricate them
ausgrid_hierarchy.target_rule: leaf targets are observed loads; region and system targets are deterministic sums of their registered descendants at the same target position
ausgrid_hierarchy.edge_rule: the 16 undirected child-parent links come only from the registered 12-leaf/4-region/system hierarchy; self-loops are added only inside convolution normalization
ausgrid_hierarchy.scope: an accounting hierarchy, not a claimed electrical feeder topology

opsd_dense.target_rule: the selected country's observed load at processed position t+24
opsd_dense.edge_rule: undirected edge iff absolute Pearson correlation is at least 0.7 on at least 168 pairwise-finite rows strictly before the split's training cutoff
opsd_dense.scope: a training-window functional graph, not physical transmission topology

hyperbolic_specification.layer: log_0^c -> shared linear transform -> normalized-adjacency aggregation -> ReLU in tangent space -> exp_0^c
hyperbolic_specification.readout: log_0^c followed by the prediction head shared with Euclidean GCN

mandatory_predecessors.CSA-LoadNet: retain the accepted p2_s3_identifiable_v1 matched null and do not rename it HGCN
mandatory_predecessors.DLinear: retain as a mandatory strong non-graph comparator and preserve its adverse exact-hierarchy result

result_policy: This stage validates implementation invariants only. It supplies no forecast metric, superiority claim, pilot evidence, or formal result.
